{{Top|leg}}
A '''treddroid''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] used in [[Mining/Legends|mining]] and related practices. One was present on [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]] in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], where it supervised a mining probe (an [[Unidentified EM-Two probe droid|Em-2 unit]]), and was used by [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Plagueis]], to assist in investigating a [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] seam.<ref name="DarthPlagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
